title: One recruiter decision, 50 workers (with GS.06b minimum-wage change)
story: A single decision fans out as 50 per-subject commands driven by persisted messages. Added schedule GS.06b: a work location's minimum wage changes (one shared referenced entity).
checked: Each subject commits once, in order; no cross-subject transaction; all 50 visible to their next pulls. GS.06b: every worker at that location appears in the feed's affected-subject set and is re-run; no other worker is.

witnesses.positive: the 50 loc1 workers (fan-out changes their placement; GS.06b affects them through location:loc1)
witnesses.negative: loc2 workers (neither the decision nor loc1's wage reaches them)

domain: GS.06b affected-subject set = exactly the loc1 workers, all re-run (O-DOMAIN dependency rule over the :placement/location reference)

oracle.source: O-REPLAY (state, one commit per subject, no cross-subject transaction); O-DOMAIN (affected set through references)
gaps: O-REPLAY has no dependency rules; GS.06b's affected set is O-DOMAIN's
